subject: RE: Mini Industrial PoE Switch
text:
Required Specifications:

Routing Capabilities:
* IP SLA (Service Level Agreement Monitoring)
* GRE Tunneling
* PPPoE (Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet)
* BGP (Border Gateway Protocol)
* IPsec Tunnels (Site-to-Site and Remote Access VPNs)

Interface Requirements:
* 1 or 2 Fast Ethernet/Gigabit Ethernet (FE/GE) routing ports
* 2, 4, or 8 Fast Ethernet (FE) switching ports

[引文：Elsa 2025-04-09 13:11「Is something as attached OK?」]
note: 巴基斯坦 ITE（ite.net.pk）Faisal Javed：第 3 封，给出路由器规格（IP SLA / GRE / PPPoE / BGP / IPsec，1–2 GE 路由口 + 2/4/8 FE 交换口）→ 这是 CPE 路由器需求，不是 Saga 交换机产品线
